Indicator ratios card

Source: R/page-internal_consistency--ratios.R
calculate_ratios_ui.Rd

A card with one chart of the ratios between related indicators (ANC1 to Penta1, OPV1 to OPV3 and Penta1 to Penta3 have translated labels). It is the first card of the Internal consistency page (internal_consistency_ui()) and has no filters. It reads ratios_summary from the dataset.

Usage

calculate_ratios_ui(id, i18n)

calculate_ratios_server(id, cache, i18n, active = reactive(TRUE))

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

active

A reactive that is TRUE once the page has been opened with data loaded. The card does no work before that.

Value

calculate_ratios_ui() returns the card's UI as Shiny tags. calculate_ratios_server() is called for its side effects.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the card in a page module, as the Internal consistency page uses it
my_page_ui <- function(id, i18n) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  cd_page_ui(id, i18n, calculate_ratios_ui(ns("ratios"), i18n))
}
my_page_server <- function(id, cache, i18n, active = reactive(TRUE)) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    calculate_ratios_server("ratios", cache, i18n, active = active)
  })
}
} # }
